title: Read association output

blocks.what_we_do: Find the effect allele, the sample count, the uncertainty, the type of test and the fitting status in the output.
blocks.why: A1 is the [effect allele](docs/glossary.md#effect-allele): the allele whose dosage is tested. It is not automatically the ALT allele, the minor allele or the harmful allele. OR is the odds ratio. It shows how much each copy of A1 multiplies the odds of disease. OBS_CT is the number of samples used at that variant. It can change from variant to variant because of missing calls. ERRCODE describes model failures. A missing p-value must stay missing. A 95% [confidence interval](docs/glossary.md#ci) is exp(log(OR) +/- 1.96 * SE), where SE is the standard error. This formula is an approximation. The interval shows how uncertain the estimate is, if the assumptions hold. It does not give the chance that this one interval contains the true value.
blocks.command:
```{r s6-5}
results <- guided_association(guided_path(cfg, "6.4", "association"))
print(table(results$ERRCODE, useNA = "ifany"))
valid <- results[valid_p(results$P), ]
valid$CI_LOW <- exp(log(valid$OR) - 1.96 * valid[["LOG(OR)_SE"]])
valid$CI_HIGH <- exp(log(valid$OR) + 1.96 * valid[["LOG(OR)_SE"]])
top <- valid[order(valid$P), c("CHROM", "POS", "ID", "A1", "OBS_CT", "OR", "CI_LOW", "CI_HIGH", "P")]
print(head(top, 10))
guided_write(head(top, 20), guided_path(cfg, "6.5", "top20.tsv"))
guided_artifact_checkpoint(cfg, "6.5", guided_path(cfg, "6.5", "top20.tsv"), parent = "6.4")
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

Not applicable. This step needs no PLINK operation. The R chunk is the complete command.

R reads or calculates the values it shows. It does not change the genotype files.
blocks.expected_result:
The leading regions are on chromosomes 9, 3 and 12. The table keeps the effect allele and the OBS_CT of each variant. Every p-value and odds ratio refers to the tested A1 allele, whatever the variant ID looks like.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks passed on Windows; main test counts and significance match the expected values.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the input file named in the message and the previous step. Keep the command and the console log. Do not use files from a different version of the dataset. See [troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
What should you do with a row that has an ERRCODE for a failure and a missing p-value?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

Read the reason for the failure. Keep the p-value as missing. Do not replace it with a number, whether significant or not.

</details>
blocks.files_created: `s6-5_top20.tsv`, with the effect estimates and their intervals.
